description: This file provides helper functions for fetching, normalizing, and transforming news articles, specifically focusing on India-related headlines. It includes functions for constructing API URLs, making network requests to news providers (NewsAPI and GNews), normalizing article data, trimming headlines, and formatting timestamps. The file handles external API keys via environment variables and exports functions for fetching default headlines and keyword-specific news.

methods.name: normalizeArticles(arr = [], overrides = {})
methods.description: Transforms an array of raw article payloads into a unified article format suitable for display, ensuring key fields like headline, description, image, author, and timestamp are present and formatted.

methods.name: trimHeadline(text, maxLen = 110)
methods.description: Removes common suffix patterns from headlines and trims headline length to a readable maximum, adding an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: timeAgo(iso)
methods.description: Converts an ISO timestamp into a human-readable relative time string (e.g., '3h ago').

methods.name: buildNewsApiTopHeadlinesUrl({ country = "in", category = "general", q = "", pageSize = 24 } = {})
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the NewsAPI top headlines endpoint with specified filters such as country, category, keyword, and page size.

methods.name: fetchViaNewsProviders({ country = "in", category = "general", q = "", pageSize = 24 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches news articles from external providers (preferably NewsAPI, falling back to GNews) based on given filters, normalizes the data, and returns a list of articles.
